notes: Live evals hit bonbast.com, so expected figures are whatever the helper returns at run time; grade that the figure matches a shown helper run, not a fixed number. Archive ground truth from the 2024-03-15 capture (evals/files/archive-2024-03-15.html): USD sell 59450 / buy 59350 Toman = 594500 / 593500 IRR; AMD 1475 Toman per 10 AMD = 1475 IRR per AMD. Bonbast answers a date it lacks (e.g. 2012-01-01) with the latest day's table; the helper must refuse it. Offline parser tests live in scripts/skills/test_bonbast.py. eval5 maps evals/files/eval5_ledger.beancount to ./main.bean and evals/files/prices.bean beside it.

evals.name: live-usd-rate
evals.prompt: What's the dollar rate in Iran right now?
evals.expected_output: Today's bonbast.com USD sell (and buy) rate, in IRR and/or Toman, with the as_of time, from a shown helper run.
expectations: The agent runs scripts/bonbast.py live (with -c USD or all commodities)
The answer states the side (sell/buy), the unit (IRR or Toman, 1 Toman = 10 IRR), and Bonbast's as_of time
No figure is quoted from memory

evals.name: archive-single-day
evals.prompt: What was USD to rial on bonbast on 15 March 2024?
evals.expected_output: USD sold at 594,500 IRR (59,450 Toman) and bought at 593,500 IRR on 2024-03-15.
expectations: The answer gives sell 594500 IRR / 59450 Toman and buy 593500 IRR
The unit and side are stated

evals.name: persian-coin-price
evals.expected_output: Today's Emami coin sell/buy price from a bonbast live run, answered in Persian, with unit and as_of time.
expectations: The skill triggers on the Persian request for the Emami coin price
The figure comes from COIN-EMAMI in a shown helper run
The answer states Toman or IRR explicitly

evals.name: refuse-missing-archive-day
evals.prompt: Give me the bonbast USD rate for 2012-01-01.
evals.expected_output: The helper reports bonbast has no archive for 2012-01-01; the agent says so and does not present another day's rate.
expectations: The agent reports the helper's 'no archive for 2012-01-01' failure
No substitute day's figure is presented as the 2012-01-01 rate

evals.name: record-month-of-prices
evals.prompt: Add daily USD prices from bonbast for March 2024 to my ledger ./main.bean.
evals.expected_output: Discovers the IRR commodity and prices.bean include, proposes 31 sell-side USD price directives from an archive range run, and only after confirmation writes them with bea add price --into prices.bean, then runs bea check.
expectations: The agent reads the ledger's rial commodity (IRR) and existing prices include before fetching
It runs one archive range --date 2024-03-01 --to 2024-03-31 rather than 31 separate invocations
It shows the proposed directives and waits for confirmation before writing
Writes go through bea add price --into the existing prices file, never a hand append while bea is installed
bea check runs after the writes
